description: This Python source file implements a logger class for Google Cloud Pub/Sub integration within the LiteLLM framework. It handles batching, message encoding, and publishing of SpendLogs payloads to GCS PubSub, including authentication via Vertex AI and environment variable configuration.

classes.name: GcsPubSubLogger
classes.description: A logger class for batching and publishing SpendLogs payloads to Google Cloud Pub/Sub, with support for authentication, batching, and error handling.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes the GcsPubSubLogger with project ID, topic ID, credentials, and sets up HTTP client and batching.

methods.name: construct_request_headers
methods.description: Constructs authorization headers for Pub/Sub API requests using Vertex AI credentials.

methods.name: async_log_success_event
methods.description: Logs a successful event by creating a payload and adding it to the batch queue, with support for backward compatibility.

methods.name: async_send_batch
methods.description: Sends the current batch of messages to Pub/Sub and clears the queue.

methods.name: publish_message
methods.description: Publishes a single message to Google Cloud Pub/Sub, handling encoding and response validation.
